admission.justification: The workspace convention path and the user config folder were weighed; the choice binds discovery, installation and every settings reader.

alternatives.option: One home in the user's config folder (~/.config/agents-remember/agents-remember-settings.json, beside settings.json); discovery reads only it unless --config names a file; an install copies the old convention file there once and leaves the old copy.
alternatives.reason: It survives the retirement of the harness folders, gives every run one file, and keeps the file out of the agents' direct reach.

alternatives.option: Keep discovering the settings file at the workspace harness convention path <workspace>/.claude/mcp/agents-remember-settings.json.
alternatives.reason: It ties the product to a retired harness folder and leaves several per-harness files that can name the same root with different content.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The user's config folder stops being a place that every supported harness and the dashboard can read.

consequences: An explicit --config path is still honoured.
On a machine whose config folder is read-only, writing the file waits for the developer's word.
context: The tool-server settings file agents-remember-settings.json was discovered at the workspace harness convention path <workspace>/.claude/mcp/, and each harness root could hold its own copy naming the same coordination root with different content. The harness folders were being retired.
decider: The developer (D693 Q2, on the architect's suggestion); MIK-R84 v10 behaviour 6.
